total_funding_usd.quote: We have raised a Series A, for a total of $35m in funding.

last_round.quote: Major investors are Amplify, CRV, and HeavyBit.

note: exe.dev is founded/blogged by David Crawshaw (also behind sketch.dev, an LLM coding tool that preceded exe.dev). Launched public developer preview 2025-12-15; announced $35m total funding (Series A) on 2026-04-22 with Amplify, CRV, and HeavyBit as major investors. Exact Series A round amount and prior seed round details were not disclosed in the blog post; only the cumulative $35m figure is given.
